subtitles.text: Scale out runs over Spectrum 4 Ethernet. With three scaling laws in full steam, pre-training, post-training and inference, and now agentic systems, compute demand continues to grow exponentially.
Vera Rubin is architected for every phase of Agentic AI, advancing every pillar of computing including CPU, storage, networking, and security.
Vera Rubin NVLink 72 delivers 3.6 exaflops of compute and 260 terabytes per second of all-to-all NVLink bandwidth.
The Vera CPU rack is designed for orchestration and agentic workflows.
AI-native storage is built with BlueField 4, while Spectrum-X co-packaged optics increase energy efficiency and resiliency.
The Groq 3 LPX rack is tightly connected to Vera Rubin, adding a token accelerator to the already incredibly fast platform.
Together, Vera Rubin and Groq deliver 35 times more throughput per megawatt.
The new Vera Rubin platform has seven chips and five rack-scale computers for agentic AI.
Vera Rubin provides 40 million times more compute in just 10 years.
This is Vera Rubin: the entire system is vertically integrated completely with software, end to end optimized as one giant system.
It is designed for agentic systems because large language models are going to get larger and generate more tokens more quickly.
Large language models also have to access memory, including KV cache and structured and unstructured data.
Agents use tools that need to be as fast as possible, which is why NVIDIA reinvented the storage system.
NVIDIA created a brand new CPU designed for extremely high single-threaded performance, high data output, data processing, and energy efficiency.
